title: The Game Has Strong Words For 50 Cent As A Father
htmlContent:
The Game continues to take shots at 50 Cent. This time it was on the I Am Athlete Podcast.

During the episode, Brandon Marshall asked the former G-Unit member if he would prefer to do an album or a movie with 50, choosing the latter.

“What kind of movie? Does this n**** die in the movie?” he asked.

He detailed a plot for a film seemingly inspired by the 50s relationship with his eldest son, Marquise. He even dubbed the film Abandonment.

“I think the movie is he abandoned his son, and I come into the baby moms and show her how a real dad is,” he said. “Me and him, I don’t f*** with him because she abandoned his child, his flesh and blood. And then I come along and pick up the pieces. He doesn’t owe me nothing, but I got problems with him.”

Game continued: “Any man that don’t wanna take care of their own child for any reason, I got a problem with.”

Later in the conversation, he denied the 50 Cent's claim that he Game's first album 'The Documentary.'

“We know that’s not true because I have more classic albums than him,” he said while claiming that 50 only has “one classic album,” Get Rich or Die Tryin’.

“Me, I’ve had several, and I’m still here,” he said. “Cut all the 50 wrote for Game shit. 50 wrote for 50 and did his part.”

Game recently shared that he had to delay the release of his upcoming project “DRILLMATIC – Mind vs. Heart.”
